hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -q 'next build' && ! echo "$cmd" | grep -q -- '--webpack'; then echo '{"continue": false, "stopReason": "next build must use --webpack — Turbopack chunks cause ChunkLoadError on Cloudflare Workers (HTTP 500 on every page). Use: npm run build"}'; fi

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx)$' && [ -f "$f" ]; then result=$(npx eslint "$f" 2>&1) || true; if [ -n "$result" ]; then jq -n --arg ctx "ESLint:\n$result" '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":$ctx}}'; fi; fi
